transcript.en: First of all, let me thank you all for coming to this public meeting, to discuss the future of our town.
transcript.zh: 首先，我要感谢各位赏光出席这次公开会议，和我们共商小镇的未来。

transcript.en: Our first speaker is Shona Ferguson, from Barford town council. Shona.
transcript.zh: 我们的第一位讲话人是来自Barford镇议会的Shona Ferguson，大家掌声欢迎Shona。

transcript.en: Thank you.
transcript.zh: 谢谢

transcript.en: "First I'll briefly give you some background information, then I'll be asking you for your comments on developments in the town.
transcript.zh: 谢谢。首先我简短地给大家介绍一些背景信息，然后在小镇的发展方面再征求一下大家的意见。

transcript.en: Well, as you don't need me to tell you, Barford has changed a great deal in the last 50 years.
transcript.zh: 相信不用我说你们也都知道，这五十年来Barford已经发生了很大的变化。

transcript.en: These are some of the main changes.
transcript.zh: 我要跟你们讲的是一些主要的变化。

transcript.en: Fifty years ago, buses linked virtually every part of the town and the neighbouring towns and villages.
transcript.zh: 50年前，公交路线几乎连接着镇上的每个部分和隔壁村镇。

transcript.en: Most people used them frequently, but not now, because the bus companies concentrate on just the routes that attract most passengers.
transcript.zh: 那个时候大多数人经常乘坐公交，但是现在已经不再这样了，因为公交车公司现在只注重发展那些能够吸引大部分乘客的路线。

transcript.en: So parts of the town are no longer served by buses.
transcript.zh: 镇上有些地方已经再也没有公交车通行了。

transcript.en: Even replacing old uncomfortable buses with smart new ones
transcript.zh: 即使公交车公司将老旧的舒适感较低的公交车换成了智能的新车，

transcript.en: has had little impact on passenger numbers.
transcript.zh: 乘客数量也几乎没有增加。

transcript.en: It's sometimes said that bus fares are too high,
transcript.zh: 有时候人们认为公交车费太高了，

transcript.en: but in relation to average incomes, fares are not much higher than they were 50 years ago.
transcript.zh: 但是根据现如今大家的平均收入水平来看，目前的费用并没有比五十年前的高出很多。

transcript.en: Changes in the road network are affecting the town.
transcript.zh: 道路网的变化正在影响着小镇。

transcript.en: The centre was recently closed to traffic on a trial basis, making it much safer for pedestrians.
transcript.zh: 中心路线前段时间在试行封闭交通，为了让行人更加安全进行了整修。

transcript.en: The impact of this is being measured.
transcript.zh: 人们正在衡量这一行动的效果。

transcript.en: The new cycle paths, separating bikes from cars in most main roads,
transcript.zh: 这些新自行车道将最主要道路上的自行车和汽车分了开来，

transcript.en: are being used far more than was expected, reducing traffic and improving air quality.
transcript.zh: 人们使用新自行车道的次数比预期中要多得多，减少了交通拥堵并改善了空气质量。

transcript.en: And although the council's attempts to have a bypass constructed have failed,
transcript.zh: 虽然镇议会试图建造一条支路的想法并没有成功，

transcript.en: we haven't given up hope of persuading the government to change its mind.
transcript.zh: 但是我们不会就此放弃的，我们仍希望能够说服政府改变想法。

transcript.en: Shopping in the town centre has changed over the years.
transcript.zh: 这些年来镇中心的购物情况已经发生了变化。

transcript.en: Many of us can remember when the town was crowded with people going shopping.
transcript.zh: 我们很多人都能记得过去镇上挤满了购物的人的场景。

transcript.en: Numbers have been falling for several years,
transcript.zh: 顾客的数量这几年来仍在一直减少。

transcript.en: despite efforts to attract shoppers, for instance by opening new car parks.
transcript.zh: 即使商家已经做出了各种努力想要吸引顾客，比如建造新的停车场，

transcript.en: Some people combine shopping with visits to the town's restaurants and cafés.
transcript.zh: 有些人把购物和去镇上的餐馆和咖啡馆结合起来。

transcript.en: Most shops are small independent stores, which is good,
transcript.zh: 镇上大部分商店都是小小的独立店铺，它们虽然很棒，

transcript.en: but many people prefer to use supermarkets and department stores in nearby large towns, as there are so few well-known chain stores here.
transcript.zh: 但是很多人却更喜欢去附近大型城镇里的超市或者百货商场购物，因为本镇有名的连锁商店太少了。

transcript.en: Turning now to medical facilities,
transcript.zh: 现在我们把话题转向医疗设施，

transcript.en: the town is served by family doctors in several medical practices - fewer than 50 years ago,
transcript.zh: 我们小镇居民好几种疾病都是找家庭医生来看的，虽然现在镇上家庭医生的数量比50年前要少，

transcript.en: but each catering for far more patients.
transcript.zh: 但是他们每个人治疗的患者数量都比那时候要多得多。

transcript.en: Our hospital closed 15 years ago, which means journeys to other towns are unavoidable.
transcript.zh: 我们镇医院是15年前倒闭的，也就是说去别的镇看病在所难免。

transcript.en: On the other hand, there are more dentists than there used to be.
transcript.zh: 另一方面，镇上的牙医数量比过去要多。

transcript.en: Employment patterns have changed, along with almost everything else.
transcript.zh: 和几乎所有事情一样，就业模式也发生了变化。

transcript.en: The number of schools and colleges has increased, making that the main employment sector.
transcript.zh: 学校和学院的数量有所增加，成为了主要的就业部门。

transcript.en: Services, such as website design and accountancy, have grown in importance,
transcript.zh: 像网站设计和会计服务这样的服务行业发展极其迅猛，

transcript.en: and surprisingly, perhaps, manufacturing hasn't seen the decline that has affected it in other parts of the country.
transcript.zh: 而且令人意外的是，我们镇的制造业并没有像国内其他地方一样走向衰落。

transcript.en: Now I'll very quickly outline current plans for some of the town's facilities, before asking for your comments.
transcript.zh: 在征求大家的意见之前，我很快地概述一下我们目前对镇上的一些设施做出的计划。

transcript.en: As you'll know if you regularly use the car park at the railway station, it's usually full.
transcript.zh: 如果你们定期使用火车站的停车场的话可能知道，那里经常都没有空车位。

transcript.en: The railway company applied for permission to replace it with a multi-storey car park, but that was refused.
transcript.zh: 铁道公司申请把现有停车场改造成一座多层停车场，但这一申请被否决了。

transcript.en: Instead, the company has bought some adjoining land, and this will be used to increase the number of parking spaces.
transcript.zh: 取而代之的是，这家公司买下了一些毗邻的土地，将把这片土地建成额外的停车场，以增加停车位。

transcript.en: The Grand, the old cinema in the high street, will close at the end of the year, and reopen on a different site.
transcript.zh: 商业街上那座旧的大电影院今年年底将会关闭，在另一个地点重新开业。

transcript.en: You've probably seen the building under construction.
transcript.zh: 你们可能已经看过正在施工的那座电影院了。

transcript.en: The plan is to have three screens with fewer seats, rather than just the one large auditorium in the old cinema.
transcript.zh: 我们的计划是将电影院分成三个稍小的演播厅，而不是像旧电影院里一样只有一个大的主厅。

transcript.en: I expect many of you shop in the indoor market.
transcript.zh: 我猜你们很多人都会去室内市场买东西。

transcript.en: It's become more and more shabby - looking, and because of fears about safety, it was threatened with demolition.
transcript.zh: 但是那里看起来越来越破旧了，而且出于安全方面的考虑，人们一度想要将其拆除。

transcript.en: The good news is that it will close for six weeks to be made safe and redecorated, and the improved building will open in July.
transcript.zh: 好消息是，这个市场会关闭六个星期，用来重新装修以使其更加安全，装修好之后会在7月份开业。

transcript.en: Lots of people use the library, including school and college students who go there to study.
transcript.zh: 很多人都会去图书馆，包括学校和学院的学生都会去那儿学习。

transcript.en: The council has managed to secure funding to keep the library open later into the evening,
transcript.zh: 议会设法筹到了资金可以使图书馆延迟到傍晚再闭馆。

transcript.en: twice a week. We would like to enlarge the building in the not-too-distant future, but this is by no means definite.
transcript.zh: 每周两次。我们想要在不远的将来扩大图书馆的建筑规模，但是这个计划还不确定。

transcript.en: There's no limit on access to the nature reserve on the edge of town, and this will continue to be the case.
transcript.zh: 大家去镇边的自然保护区没有受到任何限制，未来也将继续如此。

transcript.en: What will change, though, is that the council will no longer be in charge of the area.
transcript.zh: 不过有一件将要改变的事情是，议会将不再掌管那一地区。

transcript.en: Instead it will become the responsibility of a national body that administers most nature reserves in the country.
transcript.zh: 一个管理着国内大部分自然保护区的全国性机构将负责接管这个自然保护区。

transcript.en: OK, now let me ask you...
transcript.zh: 好了，现在我要问你们...
